{{Top|leg}}
'''Research vessels''', or '''research ships''', were a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The ''[[Theoretika]]''<ref name="Theoretika">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Assertion: Repairs Required|the ''Theoretika''}}</ref> and the ''[[Jannimak]]'' was a research vessel.<ref name="Crash Site Outpost">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Crash Site Outpost}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], multiple research vessels operated in the [[Polis Massa system/Legends|Polis Massa system]].<ref name="Strongholds">{{FFG|story=Phantoms in the Dark|book=Strongholds of Resistance}}</ref>
